name: Community stakeholder interview plan
purpose: Prepare a CHNA stakeholder interview plan tied to approved community evidence.
steps: Reconcile community scope and missing voices against available evidence.
Draft interview questions, recruitment criteria and accessible participation options.
Map findings to priority-setting decisions without implying completed engagement.
acceptance: Coverage includes underserved voices or records the gap.
Questions map to priorities with dated sources.
Human owner reviews recruitment, consent and any external outreach.
